layout_strategy.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. Section padding: py-20 lg:py-28. Grid gaps: gap-6 lg:gap-8.

required_sections.name: Kinetic Hero Section

Trust tags: Creative Strategy, Performance Marketing, Content Production, Web Experiences. Right side interactive visual: Floating CSS cards (Social Media creative card, Analytics mini chart with Recharts/SVG, Reel video preview, Meta Ad Dashboard card) with floating animated blobs.

required_sections.name: Editorial Marquee Ribbon
required_sections.spec: Slow drift marquee featuring 'Creative • Strategy • Performance • Growth' in low-contrast typography with purple accent dots.

required_sections.name: About TNS CREATIONS
required_sections.spec: 'Not Just Another Marketing Agency.' 2-column layout. Left: Agency story & manifesto chapter. Right: Premium glass card showcasing 4 qualitative pillars: Strategy-First Approach, Creative Execution, Transparent Communication, Business-Focused Marketing.

required_sections.name: Core Marketing Services
required_sections.spec: 'Everything Your Brand Needs to Grow Online.' 6 interactive service cards: 1. Social Media Management, 2. Graphic Design & Branding, 3. Video Editing & Reels, 4. Meta Ads & Lead Generation, 5. Google Ads, 6. Website Design & Development. Unique Lucide icons, hover glow, 'Explore Service' detail modal/drawer.

required_sections.name: Why Choose TNS CREATIONS
required_sections.spec: 'Creative Thinking. Business-Focused Execution.' 6 benefit blocks: Dedicated Account Support, Professional Creative Quality, Fast Turnaround, Transparent Communication, Performance-Focused Strategy, Flexible Growth Packages.

required_sections.name: 3-Day Free Trial Spotlight
required_sections.spec: 'Experience TNS Before You Commit.' Glowing gradient highlighted card. Benefits checklist: Marketing Audit, 1 Professional Social Media Creative, 1 Short Reel/Video Concept, Growth Strategy Recommendations, Recommended Marketing Package. Clear disclaimer box (No paid ad budget included, No guaranteed leads/sales, No unlimited revisions). CTA 'Claim Your 3-Day Free Trial'.

required_sections.name: Selected Work Portfolio
required_sections.spec: 'Selected Work.' Filter tabs: All, Social Media, Branding, Reels, Advertising, Websites. Masonry bento grid of rich styled project cards with realistic campaign previews and stats. Clicking opens Lightbox/Modal with full case breakdown.

required_sections.name: 6-Step Growth Timeline
required_sections.spec: 'From Idea to Growth.' 6-step horizontal desktop / vertical mobile timeline: 01. Discover, 02. Strategy, 03. Create, 04. Launch, 05. Optimize, 06. Grow. Numbered manifesto style.

required_sections.name: Growth Packages & Pricing
required_sections.spec: 'Simple Plans. Serious Growth.' 3 tier pricing cards: Starter (₹7,999/mo), Growth (₹15,999/mo - 'Most Popular' gradient badge), Business Growth (₹24,999/mo). Included deliverables checklist + 'Suitable for' tag + CTA button. Ad spend disclaimer note.

required_sections.name: Industries We Serve
required_sections.spec: 'Marketing Built Around Your Business.' 8 industry focus cards: Restaurants & Cafes, Gyms & Fitness, Education & Institutes, Technology & IT, Internet Service Providers, Real Estate, Local Businesses, Professional Services.

required_sections.name: Client Testimonials
required_sections.spec: 'What Clients Say.' Grid of clearly labelled placeholder testimonial cards: 'Client testimonial will appear here.' with client role & industry indicators.

required_sections.name: Free Marketing Audit Form
required_sections.spec: 'Want to Know What Your Business Can Improve Online?' Interactive form: Full Name, Business Name, Phone, Email, Website/Instagram URL, Service Required (Dropdown), Monthly Marketing Budget (Dropdown), Message. CTA 'Request Free Audit'. Form submits to backend database API (/api/audit-requests or local state).

required_sections.name: High-Impact Conversion Banner
required_sections.spec: 'Ready to Build a Brand People Remember?' Dual CTAs: 'Start Free Trial' and 'Book Consultation'.

required_sections.name: Contact & Direct Channels
required_sections.spec: Brand contact block, placeholder Phone/Email/Website, WhatsApp Direct button (+91 direct link), Email button, Interactive Google Maps preview card.

required_sections.name: Agency Footer
required_sections.spec: Logo, tagline, Quick Navigation links, Services links, Legal links (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Refund Policy), © 2026 TNS CREATIONS.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all 16 required sections are implemented cleanly with generous spacing and dark mode aesthetics.
Use backdrop-blur glassmorphism cards with subtle 1px white/10 borders and radial purple/blue glows.
Hook up lead audit form, free trial claim modal, and consultation booking modal with toast notifications (sonner) and local API persistence.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, inputs, and key action components.
Ensure responsive design from 320px mobile up to 4K displays.
Use Lucide icons for services, features, and contact channels.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use dark colors as heavy flat gradients, keep dark backgrounds deep (#07090E) with subtle radial glow spots.
Ensure high contrast WCAG AA readability for all text elements over dark backgrounds.
Never use raw transparent backgrounds on sticky header or dropdowns; always apply backdrop-blur and semi-opaque background color.
Maintain smooth micro-interactions across hover states and form inputs.
